crime.name: Queensland Police Service Open Data Portal — Crime locations (suburb boundary API)
crime.note: Reported offences, 12-month rolling period. Suburb boundaries are QPS crime-reporting boundaries, which occasionally group small localities under a neighbouring suburb name (see boundary_note per suburb).

demographics.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics, 2021 Census of Population and Housing
demographics.note: Most recent published Census. Next Census is 2026; this data will be stale until those results are released.
